Cookies are named by art + element icon, cross-checked against authors' text: 우유 = light-element white nurse with purple banner and pink bear (matches Milk art in nv-50417-8); 브시커 = light, brown hair, purple eye; 석류 = dark, red curly hair; 실론 = light, white-bearded old knight, often 4★ (matches '실론이 4성' in 79142); 피노 = dark, grey hair, monocle (77113 author calls it 피노누아); 정전 = leaf, teal hair, orange flower; 닼초 = dark, black/red hair; 체리 = fire, orange gingerbread with red bow; 전갈 = fire, red hair; 메소 = water, green hair, goggles; 허브 = leaf, green hair (79142 '전갈빼고허브'). 피겨 = leaf, pink hair, red/white hat (by elimination, tentative). The light gold-haired Lv.100 and the water Lv.100 with headphones are 마카롱 and 치케 in some order: not resolved, written as '마카롱/치케 (light gold)' and '마카롱/치케 (water)'. Third pet slot: a white round pet with red/green trim, star count varies (10–20); no black panda markings, so likely 색동 주머니 (Candy Shade Pouch), not 판다만두 (low confidence).

posts.title_en: Gallery guild conquest results + 'underperformer detector' sheet
posts.summary_en: A guild leader shares a spreadsheet that fits ln(damage) against ln(account power) over three conquests and kicks members below 60% of expected. Fit on 30 members: b = 1.890, a = 3.967, R² = 0.755, i.e. conquest damage scales roughly with account power^1.89. Top row: 17.59G account power → 827.585G.
mechanics: Regression across 30 guild members (77287-1.jpg): ln(damage) = 3.967 + 1.890·ln(account power in G), R² 0.755. Damage grows faster than linearly with account power, so 배 is not power-neutral.

posts.title_en: Why is my conquest damage so bad?
posts.summary_en: 40G 53M at 793.97M team power (~50배) with a Cherry deck and Seeker 4★. Advice: Seeker 4★ is the limit (Seeker does ~80% of damage); if the team dies before 17 s, swap Cherry for Strawberry Crepe (full level); perks 초고속 승진 if you reach 17 s, otherwise 3-defence DR perk; low-star Seeker may prefer 갓방울 over Octo Wasabi. Preset by slot: top-left crit dmg + skill amp, top-right haste + amp, bottom-left DR + HP, bottom-right haste + DR. ATK order with Scorpion's ATK ×1.08 (Octo Wasabi synergy) below Cheesecake.

substitutions: 체리 → 딸크 (full level) if the team dies before 17 s
와사비 문어 → 갓방울 for low-star Seeker

mechanics: Octo Wasabi's synergy multiplies Scorpion's ATK by 1.08 for the ATK-order comparison, but not Cheesecake's; tune Scorpion so ATK×1.08 < Cheesecake's ATK.
Seeker does ~80% of the team's damage; Seeker 4★ vs 5★ is nearly a 2x difference (commenters).
disagreements: Commenter: Skating Queen can just be Lv.100, since the top three in ATK order can be in any order.

posts.title_en: Guild Conquest 1T guide
posts.summary_en: Guide by 서신우 (1T 49G, guild rank 2, nv-48773-2.png); the body image nv-48773-1.jpg is an empty file, so the guide content itself was not captured. In comments he advises against spending pet slots on survival: the boss respawns harder after each explosion, so staying alive barely extends the run and losing a damage pet costs more, so just take the 17 s wipe. Herb only for newbies who can't survive without it; Tiger Lily even with junk runes beats Herb. Pinot runes go to HP because skill amp doesn't apply to Pinot and haste barely helps; Pomegranate ending up 3rd in ATK order is fine.

sugar_runes.why: Skill amp doesn't apply to Pinot; its cooldown ≈ duration so haste does little; it's an arena cookie so take survival

mechanics: Each time the boss explodes and returns it comes back tougher, so extra survival barely lengthens damage time (author).
Skill amp does not apply to Pinot Noir.
Pinot's skill cooldown ≈ its duration, so haste gives little.
Pomegranate (no ATK% runes) landing 3rd in ATK order is fine.
disagreements: Author: don't add survival (King Choco Drop, Herb), take the 17 s wipe. Contradicted by gallery posts 79169/79270/80067/79493 where surviving the 17 s wipe adds 300G+.
Commenter 쥬르박: after 30 s Milk starts dying first.

quotes.kr: 추가로 생존을 챙기는 건 그렇게 한다고 더 버텨지지도 않고 버틴다고 해도 그거 때문에 기존 펫이 빠진 만큼 어차피 데미지가 낮아져서 그냥 평소처럼 쓰고 17초에 전멸되는 것이 더 좋습니다
quotes.en: Adding survival doesn't make you last much longer, and even if it does, the pet you dropped costs damage anyway, so it's better to play normally and get wiped at 17 s

quotes.kr: 잡옵이어도 정전이 더 좋고 허브는 17초까지 가야 되는데 허브를 넣으면 생존이 편하지만
quotes.en: Even with junk options Tiger Lily is better; Herb makes survival easier but you need to reach 17 s

quotes.kr: 피노는 증폭이 적용되지 않는 쿠키라 증폭이 필요 없고 스킬 쿨타임과 지속 시간이 비슷해서 가속도 큰 효과가 필요 없기 때문에 아레나에서 사용하는 쿠키라 생존이라도 챙기는 것입니다

posts.title_en: Oct 8 (Thu) update notes
posts.summary_en: Oct 8 patch: new SSR 샤르도네맛 쿠키 (Chardonnay), leaf-element support, whose barrier grants allies in a straight line crit rate and push resistance (밀어내기 저항) plus multi-hit (다발) synergy. Cookie max level raised to 120; Gnome Lab basic research to 130-2 (screenshot: research 130-2 = HP amp 60.00%) and special research to 22. Cookie EXP for Lv.79–100 cut sharply (Lv.100 13,911,155 → 3,347,644) with refunds. 7-day attendance gives Milk (Crunchy Strong Pediatrician) SSR on day 7; King Choco Drop roulette event.
mechanics: Chardonnay (SSR, leaf, support): straight-line barrier gives crit rate and push resistance to allies on the line and multi-hit (다발) synergy; damages enemies (nv-50417 body; nv-50417-2.gif card shows 풀속성 · 지원).
Cookie level cap 100 → 120.
Gnome Lab basic research extended to 130-2, special research to 22; nv-50417-5.png shows research 130-2 = 체력 증폭 (HP amp) 60.00% at 10/10 MAX.
Cookie EXP for Lv.79–100 reduced (e.g. Lv.99 11,820,527 → 2,391,174; Lv.100 13,911,155 → 3,347,644), excess refunded.
Milk Cookie's Crunchy Strong Pediatrician (SSR) is the day-7 reward of a new 7-day attendance event (nv-50417-8.png).
초코왕방울 (King Choco Drop) roulette event (nv-50417-7.png).
Nothing in the notes about Guild Conquest, its boss, seasons, pets' stats or plates.

quotes.kr: 신록의 장벽으로 직선 상의 아군에게 치명확률과 밀어내기 저항을 올려 주고 다발 시너지를 제공하며, 적에게 피해를 입힙니다.
quotes.en: With the Verdant Barrier she raises crit rate and push resistance for allies in a straight line, provides multi-hit synergy, and damages enemies.
